title: Agent calls to Tracy's own server go over the internal origin, and a failed one is never said as the site not answering
steps: S1: build the call address with an internal origin set, and without it.
S2: a relay call to tracy-web that throws on both tries.
expect: S1: with MCP_TRACY_API_ORIGIN the call goes to the internal origin; without it, to the public one.
S2: COWORK_WEB_UNREACHABLE, asked twice; its next says the call did not reach Tracy's own server and never tells the customer the site is not answering.
evidence: Issue #208: Apply door calls hairpinned through the public address and timed out; the agent then told the customer their site was not answering

cmd: --test-name-pattern=\(#208\)|a relay that throws is an answer
tests: a host that names an internal origin sends its calls there; the public origin stays for people (#208)
